events.title: Difficulty Update
events.summary: Hello, Operatives!We’re rolling out a few difficulty adjustments to make your first expeditions into Xenomire a smoother experience.The goal is to give new operatives more room to get their bearings, learn how to handle threats, and find their footing during those first few runs. We want the challenge to feel fair while keeping the tension that makes every successful extraction rewarding.These are small adjustments, and we’ll keep watching how they affect your expeditions. events.title: Xenomire DEMO is coming to Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hello Operatives. XENOMIRE new DEMO is coming to Steam Next Fest with new content! The updated demo introduces augmented enemies with speical effects, side quests, new weapons and loot, environmental hazards, and reworked specializations.New threats to face, new builds to try, and more to discover.Play the demo October 19–26 and wishlist XENOMIRE on Steam!See you on Vespera.

events.title: Xenomire Dev Update #1: What's Coming in October
events.summary: It's been almost a month since our last patch, and while things have been quiet on our end, that doesn't mean we've been slacking off! First things first: our new demo is coming in the second half of October! We've been hard at work on new features, improvements, and gameplay changes, and we can't wait for you to try them out. events.title: Operatives Report: Demo Statistics
events.summary: Operatives, it’s time to take a look at what’s been happening on Vespera.Since the launch of the Xenomire demo, thousands of expeditions have been started, hundreds of operatives have been lost, and a surprisingly large number of you decided that one more run was a perfectly reasonable idea.We’ve been collecting anonymous gameplay statistics throughout the demo to better understand how you play, which weapons you gravitate toward, what objectives you prefer, where expeditions usually go wrong, a

events.title: Key Rebinding Update
events.summary: Hello Operatives,This update brings more control customization to Xenomire.You can now rebind your controls, making it easier to set up the game the way you prefer. We’ve also added toggle options for crouching and sprinting, so you can choose between hold and toggle behavior for both actions.These changes were highly requested, and we hope they make expeditions more comfortable for everyone.

events.title: Patch Note - Fixes and improvements

events.title: Demo difficulty adjusting

With that in mind, we’ve slightly adjusted enemy stats to see how these changes affect your missions.We encourage you to join our Discord server and share your feedback. events.title: Xenomire Demo joins Ukranian Game Festival 2026!
events.summary: Our free demo is live now on Steam, as a part of Ukrainian Games Festival 2026.Explore Vespera, complete missions, find powerful gear, and see how far you can push your expedition before things get out of control.Also, we want to hear from you and what you think about Xenomire — join our Discord, share your feedback, report anything you run into, and show us your best extractions results.Your feedback will help us shape Xenomire as we continue development.
